To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
• Algorand is the first truly democratic and efficient public ledger.

Algorand: • is a democratic and scalable public ledger, • is based on a novel and efficient consensus mechanism, • is secure in the sense that no adversary with less than 50% of the coins can ever corrupt the ledger, and • is provably secure in the sense of being able to achieve consensus in a finite number of rounds, and with overwhelming probability.
Algorand is the first scalable and democratic public ledger.

the design and analysis of a public ledger that is: (i) democratic, in that all parties can participate in the process of generating new transactions and blocks, (ii) efficient, in that all the parties need to do a negligible amount of work to participate in the process, and (iii) secure, in that it is very unlikely that the ledger will fork, and the ledger will not be corrupted by a malicious party.
